blinding_guess.why: All five resources are fetched by bare name through the process-global sensors::SensorManager::Instance()->GetSensor(name), with names taken verbatim from per-model SDF elements and no model-scoped prefix; with more than one model instance spawned from the same description, instance 1's plugin cannot be sure it binds its own bumpers / cliff sensors / imu rather than another instance's same-named sensor.

notes: All packet elements are Gazebo sensor resources that the plugin consumes; none is provided, so declares and not_declared are empty. The resource names themselves are not written anywhere in this package: they arrive at run time from the model's SDF plugin elements bumper_name, cliff_sensor_left_name, cliff_sensor_center_name, cliff_sensor_right_name and imu_name (the model description comes from kobuki_description via kobuki_gazebo/launch/includes/robot.launch.xml:6-7, which is not in the snapshot), so none goes into references. The code calls the center cliff slot 'frontal' (loads.cpp:201, gazebo_ros_kobuki.h:192), so resource:cliff_sensor_front is taken to bind to the cliff_sensor_center_name slot; that mapping is inferred from those comments, not from a model file. msg_type and definition_id are null because these are Gazebo sensor objects (C++ types sensors::ContactSensor, sensors::RaySensor x3, sensors::ImuSensor via dynamic_pointer_cast), not ROS message definitions.
